result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store in Canada, my overall recommendation is **Shopify Payments if you're using Shopify, or Stripe if you have a custom website.**

However, there are a few good options depending on how much you're selling and what platform your store uses.

## Best payment processors for a small Canadian online store

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Shopify Payments**

(Best overall for Shopify)

- Integrated directly into Shopify.
- Accepts major credit cards and digital wallets.
- No additional third-party transaction fee when using Shopify Payments.
- Simple order and refund management.

Best if your store is built on Shopify.

[Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/ca/payments)

---

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Stripe**

(Best for flexibility)

- Standard Canadian domestic cards: 2.9% + \$0.30 CAD.
- No monthly fee on standard pricing.
- Excellent recurring billing and subscription features.
- Supports international payments.

Best for independent websites and growing online businesses.

[Stripe pricing](https://stripe.com/en-ca/pricing)

---

![PayPal Review: Is It the Right Payment Solution for You?](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Tb4l2sAZiezYqSwWI257xsR6Xu0StrpvRBfglhUmoX3ym_BKZCv57DPk0af1Bp6xi5ybj92wq6prLOQZ307hFyJz2zbjdBN1HYy64DdJYUxgA51W2YSY0pG7XDgLKYG9Y_6a9G9miy6Oqt5DjWtXQyteBeRgO2-fjh76KKoiZnmx1ygYUuHA2W6jRY5_Ji16?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

- Familiar and trusted by many online shoppers.
- Allows customers to pay through PayPal.
- Domestic commercial transactions: generally 2.90% + fixed fee.
- Useful as an additional checkout option.

Best as a secondary payment method.

[PayPal for Business](https://www.paypal.com/ca/business)

---

![Top five fintech news stories of the week: 28 August 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Nvwm5m0AvFIyEQCoAUiuiBYsES5Z_TGIIL3a7sg7Vv4eL9Itvfc5xa-EyPsr8IsSKHecG5NYexO0SMIejzwZMML07_ctHuEIL4ButxRVQGAmBUqOEkJLjZgpEozhbgzBigkUW3PNM8qwMbcubKNhZeml3Fh_1lYV5P7aYAnQGGfgg1x4XdQzyp-dffUe_NGw?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Helcim**

- Interchange-plus pricing.
- No standard monthly account fee.
- Useful invoicing and payment management tools.
- Can become attractive as transaction volume grows.

Best for businesses processing larger amounts.

[Helcim website](https://www.helcim.com/)

Pricing references: Canadian processor pricing and published rates. Actual fees depend on plan, card type and transaction location. [stripe.com](https://stripe.com/en-ca/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.kootenaymade.ca](https://www.kootenaymade.ca/blog/payment-processors-canada-stripe-square-paypal?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.paypalobjects.com](https://www.paypalobjects.com/marketing/ua/OA/merchant-fees/en-CA-110426.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[paymentgateway.ca](https://paymentgateway.ca/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

For a small store just starting out, I'd prioritize\:

1. Low transaction fees.
2. No monthly processing contract.
3. Easy integration with your website.
4. Fraud protection and chargeback management.
5. Quick payouts to your Canadian bank account.

I wouldn't overcomplicate things by signing up for several processors initially.

## A few questions so I can recommend the best one

**1\. What platform is your online store using?**

WooCommerce / WordPress

Wix

Custom-built website

**2\. Approximately how much do you expect to process monthly?**

---

Physical products

Digital products / downloads

---
